en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a hilly rural town taken from an elevated slope. In the foreground, a man in early 20th‑century clothing sits on the grassy hillside beside a pollarded tree. Below him are half‑timbered farmhouses with steep tiled roofs, barns, and small garden plots surrounded by fences. Further back, more traditional half‑timbered houses and modest masonry buildings fill the valley, with narrow lanes, telegraph poles, and scattered leafless trees. Forested hills and open countryside extend into the distance under a bright, overexposed sky. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
